note: Frames name the chart, never a trait. Drafted by Claude 2026-10-18, review pending. anchor_palace: the same frames for any palace other than Mệnh ({palace}). via: a concept of the chapter's kind read only at another palace ({from}, {S}). vcd = the reading rests on the opposite palace's stars; vcd_own = it rests on stars standing in the empty palace ({own}); vcd_plain = neither (chart-level facts).
